bioconda.name: turbo-picard-picard-shim
bioconda.summary: Optional picard command shim for turbo-picard.
bioconda.description:
Installs a picard compatibility entrypoint backed by turbo-picard. This
package intentionally conflicts with upstream picard because it shadows the
same command name. See CITATION.cff for the software citation and the
documentation for the separate real-data evidence citations.
